title: ALL CAPS: THE HISTORY OF THE AMERICAN BASEBALL HAT
chaptersLine: Forty-plus chapters drafted, plus an introduction and a closing coda.
spanLine: From before the Civil War to the drops of 2026.
thisWeek: The three rolling production ledgers all moved on September 1, the market read, the production and photo rights, and the running list of open questions.
Photo rights and image selection stayed the center of the week, lining up what the book will be allowed to show.
No new research intake landed this week, so the manuscript held steady while the production side did the moving.
chapterHighlights: A single 1996 World Series phone call, and the red Yankees cap that broke a rule nobody thought could bend.
The small side patch that can turn an ordinary fitted into a grail.
The free-cap economy of rural America, and a farmer sitting on a hundred thousand caps.
An expansion team's teal and purple, and how it rewired the colors of American sports.
